name: Pteribit · Gremlet #40
description:
A peach pterosaur chick with a swept-back crest. Glides better than it flaps.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Pteribit in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
